newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil gov't says CVRD ruling applies to all cases.
newsitem.headline: Brazil gov't says CVRD ruling applies to all cases.

text.p: Brazil's Planning Ministry believes a high court ruling on the sale of mining group Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) applies to all outstanding injunctions, a spokesman said.

The spokesman for Planning Minister Antonio Kandir said officials had still to study the court ruling in detail, but said they understood it revoked all court injunctions issued before the ruling was made public.
"We have still to see the order, but the understanding among our lawyers is that this is the case," he told Reuters.
Privately government sources said they did not think the auction would go ahead immediately on Monday night, but did not rule anything out.

Earlier Justice Democrito Reinaldo of the Superior Court of Justice ruled in favour of a government petition and revoked injunctions relating to 27 court cases blocking the CVRD auction since April 29.
The judge's ruling did not immediately make clear whether or not it also revoked a new injunction issued by a Rio de Janeiro court on Monday afternoon.
Justice Reinaldo named the same federal court in Rio as the tribunal to rule on the merit itself of the cases.
The government petition had argued that all lawsuits against the CVRD sale should be considered by a single tribunal because of a conflict of interpretation among lower courts.
The National Development Bank, which runs Brazil's privatization program, earlier rescheduled the auction of 45 percent of CVRD's voting shares for Tuesday.
